verdict.rationale: Twenty ships an official CLI. The GitHub README shows `npx create-twenty-app` for scaffolding and `npx twenty app:publish --private` for publishing. A dedicated docs CLI page lists commands such as `dev`, which watches source files and live-syncs changes. The documented scope covers app development (objects, fields and views as code), not general CRM operations. missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands for querying or managing CRM records and workspaces, agent-oriented features (e.g., machine-readable output or AI-workflow integration), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
